method: Identical selected131 builds/stats/gear/16seeds. Remove one contribution or adjust only Enchant Poison ratio/duration; all slot costs and timing remain. Counterfactual marginal effects interact and must not be summed.
crit_metric_note: physical_crit_rate is observed critical physical damage events / all physical damage events, including non-crittable passive procs; it is not the formula critChance.
